calibration:
Calibration: recent tasks under these rules and how often the reference agent solved them (target: 1-3 of 5 runs).
Per kind: spec/other: 1 task(s), 4/5; task/other: 1 task(s), 4/5
- address-normaliser-rule-recovery: 4/5 -> too_easy (agent median 11 steps, reached the faulty files on turn 2). Recover ordered rewrite rules from 900 before/after address pairs and implement a Python normaliser that reproduces the retired engine on unseen addresses.
- bonded-warehouse-excise-return: 4/5 -> too_easy (All four runs passed. The task was well-specified: the procedure manual clearly defined each duty-calculation rule (sales, transfers, returns, evaporation tolerance), the two-step filing process with retry/idempotency, and the confirmation-archival requirement. Agents that read the manual thoroughly and fixed each listed bug in file_return.py succeeded. The task's combination of a detailed spec, explicit bug list, and practice data gave agents enough guidance to get every check right.). File a bonded warehouse's month-end excise-duty return across the local ERP, stock ledger and filing portal, following the in-house procedure document.
Make this design harder than the too_easy ones through what the agent cannot verify: held-out instances, invisible traps, rare cases that cost more than the margin. Make it easier than the too_hard ones.
